description:
Team Description (under 500 characters):

We are a four-person student team from Multan, Pakistan, combining software development, cybersecurity experience, and a love of astronomy. We are building a fast public web tool that turns SPHEREx sky data into a time-lapse for any coordinates, with adjustable field of view, image add/subtract, on-the-fly spectra, URL-based queries, and easy data updates, so anyone can spot moving objects and help make discoveries.
